caption: The drawing depicts an ornate rectangular mirror frame rendered in brown and yellow tones. The frame has a detailed, symmetrical design with a notched upper border and outward-curving bottom corners that end in small scroll shapes. At the top center of the frame sits a three-dimensional, gold-colored eagle with outstretched wings perched on a plinth. The upper part of the frame also includes two curved, gold-colored decorative elements on either side of the eagle. Gold detailing accents the inner and outer edges of the frame, and the sides are adorned with hanging, gold-colored floral garlands. The inner section, void of any glass or reflection, is left blank. The background of the drawing is plain and light, and handwritten text near the bottom reads "Sketch - Mirror Frame 1800" and "David S. DeVoe."
title: Mirror Frame
